name: neuCentrIX Sepaku
notes: Data Center Map lists neuCentrIX Sepaku at Jl. Pattimura No.96 in Balikpapan; PeeringDB also lists neuCentrIX Sepaku and neuCentrIX Balikpapan Batu Ampar under Telkom/Telin facilities. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Mitrakom Data Center (MDC) Kupang
notes: Data Center Map lists one Kupang colocation facility, MDC Kupang, at Jl. Fetor Foenay No. 8. Capacity not supplied.

name: Telkom Tier-2 Kupang data center
notes: Kontan reported Telkom's 2023 plan for seven data center locations including a Tier-2 data center in Kupang. No public MW disclosed; later public directory evidence confirms at least one Kupang data center market listing.

name: Gorontalo provincial government data/informatics center program
notes: Gorontalo Province 2023-2026 strategic-plan PDF discusses strengthening coordination with the Pusat Data dan Informatika and GO-DIGI digitalization. This is public-sector data-center/informatics infrastructure rather than a commercial colocation facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Digital Edge EDGE2
notes: EDGE2 is a 23MW South Jakarta facility on Jl. Kuningan Mulia; construction began in 2022 and launch was reported in February 2024.

name: Equinix JK1 Jakarta IBX
notes: Equinix lists JK1 in Jakarta's CBD; company newsroom says first phase has 550 cabinets, with 1,600 cabinets and 5,300 sqm colocation space at full build. MW not disclosed.

name: SMX01 Jakarta
developer: SM+ Data Centers / LG Sinar Mas
notes: SM+ broke ground on a Jakarta flagship data center in 2025; DCD reported topping-out in May 2026, 6MW phase 1 ready-for-service target in Q4 2026 and 27MW at completion.

name: SM+ Jakarta SME edge data center
notes: SM+ lists 24 nationwide edge data centers totaling 10MW today; LinkedIn location data includes Jakarta at Jl. Menteng Atas. Per-site MW not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Karet Tengsin
notes: NeutraDC/Baxtel list neuCentrIX Karet Tengsin in Jakarta as part of the Telkom edge data-center ecosystem; NeutraDC says neuCentrIX spans 19 Indonesia locations. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SM+ Jambi SME24
notes: SM+ official edge-DC page lists Jambi SME24 among its 24 nationwide edge locations; Data Center Map gives address at Jl. Rd Poerboyo Kolopaking No.15, Simpang IV Sipin. Per-site capacity not supplied.

name: neuCentrIX Tanjung Karang
notes: Telkom official release says it commercialized neuCentrIX Tanjung Karang in Bandar Lampung; DCD reported Telkom had 23 neuCentrIX/NeutraDC facilities across 17 metros and more than 1,000 racks total, but no per-site MW.

name: SM+ Lampung SME15
notes: Data Center Map lists SM+ Lampung SME15 at Jl. Arif Rahman Hakim No.68 in Bandar Lampung. Capacity not supplied.

name: Mitrakom Data Center (MDC) Ambon
notes: Data Center Map lists one Ambon colocation facility, MDC Ambon, at Jl. Laksdya Wattimena in Ambon Passo. Capacity not supplied.
